label: Email
description: An email address: its provider, a disposable domain, a public Gravatar profile, the names of the breaches it appears in; sign-up probes only after the user's yes, never the mail server

criteria.high: two independent links name the same owner (a verified Gravatar account, a page the owner runs that publishes the address, a registry)
criteria.medium: one public profile or page names the owner, nothing contradicts it
criteria.low: the local part or the domain only

criteria.high: the domain accepts mail and a recent sign is read (a profile edited this year, the address on a live page)
criteria.medium: the domain accepts mail and older signs agree (breaches, a profile, sign-up hits)
criteria.low: the domain accepts mail, nothing else

bins.off: account-probe (Holehe, after the user's yes) is off; every other step runs
